newsitem.title: FRANCE: ANA to handle French sales for Nippon Cargo.
newsitem.headline: ANA to handle French sales for Nippon Cargo.

text.p: All Nippon Airways Co Ltd (ANA) said it had been appointed French cargo sales agent for Japanese cargo airline, Nippon Cargo Airlines, effective October 1.
"NCA previously had an office at Charles de Gaulle airport but this was closed about three years ago and since then the airline has been absent from the French market," an ANA official told Reuters.

ANA will organise trucking services from France carrying feeder traffic to three of NCA's weekly Boeing 747 freighter frequencies between Amsterdam and Tokyo, the official said. --Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 8982 Fax +44 171 542 5017
